tooltip.lucastweaks.vault_reset_enabled: When enabled, trial chamber vaults will periodically reset, allowing players to loot them again.
tooltip.lucastweaks.vault_reset_minutes: How often vaults reset their rewarded players list, in minutes.
tooltip.lucastweaks.stonecutter_damage_e: When enabled, players standing on a stonecutter will take damage every tick, the same as standing on a magma block.
tooltip.lucastweaks.bluestone_enabled: When enabled, Bluestone wire maintains full signal strength over any distance instead of losing power like Redstone.
tooltip.lucastweaks.stackable_totems_ena: When enabled, Totems of Undying can stack up to 64 instead of being limited to 1.
tooltip.lucastweaks.secondary_toolbar_en: Shows a second toolbar above the hotbar displaying tools and weapons from your inventory. Use Shift+Scroll to select and swap items.
tooltip.lucastweaks.secondary_toolbar_sl: Number of slots displayed in the secondary toolbar (1-9).
tooltip.lucastweaks.elytra_banner_enable: When enabled, you can apply banner patterns to an elytra by crafting them together. The elytra will display the banner's base color.
